items.sentence: [MASK] alleged that, although the Agency completed a desk audit of her position in 2016 and determined that her position was properly graded at the GS-13 level, there were inaccuracies in her position description under the “Scope and Effect” and “Supervisory Controls” sections.
Complainant stated that she repeatedly raised these inaccuracies with management beginning in [MASK], to no avail.
The OSPE Deputy Director (DD-1) stated that she met with Complainant on [MASK], as Complainant was preparing to return to OSPE from a detail.

Complainant averred that neither DD-1 nor the Associate Director of the Acquisition Policy Oversight and Business Strategies Division (AD), Complainant’s new supervisor as of [MASK], knew her actual job duties because they were new to OSPE and, therefore, were not qualified to assess her position description.
Complainant stated that in [MASK], she noticed that a coworker (Coworker) had saved her investigative affidavit for Complainant’s prior EEO complaint to the M-60 shared drive.
